portable_spec.description: Letter-spacing animation on a title-scale slot. Per-character split mode; letter-spacing tweens from wide (1.2 em) to tight (0 em) over the enter window. CSS-rasterizable per the ADR-0011 amendment two-clause rule — qualifies as a catalog entry rather than a Pipeline.
portable_spec.inspiration: Editorial title cards where the headline arrives airy and tightens to its rest state as part of the enter.
portable_spec.usage_notes: Title-scale only (per-character on body-scale text reads as noise). Pairs well with reduced enter motion on neighbouring slots so the tightening reads as the primary motion.
